title: Scorecard: enable Branch-Protection on master (0/10)
description: Reason: 'branch protection not enabled on development/release branches'. Enable a branch protection rule / ruleset on master: require PR before merge, require status checks (ci-fast, ci), require at least 1 approving review, dismiss stale approvals, no force-push. GitHub settings change (admin). Also raises the Code-Review score. See https://docs.github.com/repositories/configuring-branches-and-merges-in-your-repository/managing-protected-branches
notes: Applied via GitHub API: require PR + required checks (Quality Gate, Lint/Build/Test), strict up-to-date, no force-push, no required approvals (solo maintainer), admins not enforced.

title: Scorecard: fix Token-Permissions (0/10)
description: Reason: 'detected GitHub workflow tokens with excessive permissions'. All workflows have top-level permissions, but these grant WRITE at top level: ci.yml (pull-requests: write), nightly-audit.yml (issues: write), nightly-spec-drift.yml (issues: write), release-please.yml (contents: write, pull-requests: write). Fix: keep top-level 'contents: read' (or {}) and move each write scope down to the specific job that needs it. Quick, code-only win.

title: Improve OpenSSF Scorecard (currently 6.7/10)
description: Scorecard run 2026-08-24 = 6.7. Five checks score 0: Token-Permissions, Branch-Protection, Code-Review, Signed-Releases, CII-Best-Practices. Contributors=3 is largely inherent to a single-org project (not filed). Badge/viewer: https://scorecard.dev/viewer/?uri=github.com/lgriffin/ESI.ts

title: Adopt beads for team issue tracking
description: Roll out bd (beads) as the shared work tracker for ESI.ts. Umbrella for the adoption tasks.

title: Scorecard: raise Code-Review (0/10)
description: Reason: 'Found 0/8 approved changesets'. PRs are merged without a recorded approval. Remediation: route all changes through PRs that receive an approving review before merge (even a co-maintainer/second-account review). Enforced by branch protection, so this depends on that rule being in place.

title: Scorecard: sign releases / add provenance (0/10)
description: Reason: 'Project has not signed or included provenance with any releases.' Options: publish to npm with --provenance (npm publish --provenance, needs id-token: write in the release job) and/or attach signed artifacts + SLSA provenance to GitHub Releases. Verify release.yml / release-please.yml emit provenance.

title: Enable git-diffable issue export (export.auto)
description: Run 'bd config set export.auto true' so .beads/issues.jsonl is written after writes, giving a human-readable, diffable record in git alongside Dolt sync.

title: Document bd workflow in CONTRIBUTING/README
description: Add a short section: install bd, run 'bd setup claude' locally (settings.json is gitignored), and use 'bd ready' to pick up work.
notes: Delivered by guides/BEADS.md + README Contributing link (merged in PR #196).

title: Scorecard: earn OpenSSF Best Practices badge (0/10)
description: Reason: 'no effort to earn an OpenSSF best practices badge detected'. Register the project at https://www.bestpractices.dev/, complete the passing-level questionnaire, then add the badge to README. Admin/documentation task.

title: Wire 'npm run schema:drift' results into beads
description: When schema:drift finds Zod schemas out of sync with the OpenAPI spec, file a bead per drift so remediation is tracked with dependencies.
